historical_record.description: The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to rehabilitate McCoppin Square to E. L. Dunn & Son of San Pablo at $20,424.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded the contract to convert the convenience station at McCoppin Square into a field house to Wilco Construction Co. at $19,474.
On the Superintendent's recommendation the Park Commission granted the Library Commission permission to build a branch library in the south part of McCoppin Square, to the plot plan it had submitted.
